findings.claim: Section 6.4 + Section 9.2 + the PRE-REGISTER implementation slice: 'search_history_ledger.jsonl contributes its per-family attempt count as research_trial_count when a sealed cohort is assembled for a QM-RESEARCH-derived candidate, so the deflated Sharpe reflects how many bites the research search took.' (test: 'research_trial_count derived from family attempt count').
findings.evidence: dsr_cohort.py:751-768 computes research_trial_count = len(research_peers) and effective_trial_count = len(peers), all reconstructed from a SEALED DL-089 census; module docstring L1-8: 'deliberately fail closed ... accepts only a sealed DL-089 ledger whose complete declared annual/numeric search can be reconstructed ... Missing or pruned trials are UNAVAILABLE; never represented by zeroes or a survivor-only subset.' The cohort is 'for new Q08 work items' (L1) and search_history.unit='candidate_configuration', annual_measurements_are_trials=False (L758-761). Directive #5/#23 and decision #5: 'no gate-threshold changes'; ROT zone (CLAUDE.md): 'gate thresholds & contract criteria' never autonomous. Draft §0/§12 itself asserts the layer 'never writes a gate verdict' and 'no gate-threshold change'.
findings.problem: research_trial_count / effective_trial_count are the deflated-Sharpe inputs to the Q08 DSR gate. Injecting a research-hypothesis-family count into that field (a) changes a gate input for a class of candidates = a gate-contract/ROT change the directive forbids autonomously, (b) directly contradicts the draft's own no-gate-change invariant, (c) is a category error — the DSR field counts sealed parameter-census candidate configurations (unit='candidate_configuration'), not research-search families, and (d) is technically unimplementable without breaking dsr_cohort's fail-closed sealing (it refuses any count not reconstructable from the sealed ledger). This weakens/alters evidence and the gate. The audit (critic.md §7) raised the concern; the draft mis-resolves it by crossing into ROT.
findings.fix: Remove all coupling to dsr_cohort.research_trial_count/effective_trial_count. Keep research-search trial accounting entirely inside the research layer's own search_history_ledger.jsonl and surface it ONLY to (1) Fable's preregistration decision, (2) the ATTACK critic prompt, and (3) research reporting/stats_corrections.py (Deflated Sharpe / BH-FDR computed on the RESEARCH ledger, not the Q08 cohort). If OWNER later wants the research family-count folded into the Q08 DSR deflation, raise it as an explicit ROT gate-contract decision package — do not implement it in this layer. Delete the 'research_trial_count derived from family attempt count' test assertion tied to DSR.

findings.claim: Section 7 + Section 3.1: 'source = Kimi without a resolvable, sha-verified artifact is invalid (decision #2)'; the implementation plan's R1 slice tests assert 'author=Kimi without artifact FAILS; missing hash fails closed'. The 'one required code change' is scoping the prescreen ML scan; farmctl _card_r1_build_ready and approve-card 'no change — already passes'.
findings.evidence: farmctl.py:4229-4237 _card_r1_build_ready = bool(str(fm.get('source_id') or '').strip()); R_STRICT_PASS_FIELDS = (r2_mechanical,r3_data_available,r4_ml_forbidden), R1 excluded (farmctl.py:4219). card_intake_prescreen.evaluate_card (L492-559) has NO source/hash check at all (audit cards_r1_research §1c). research_source.py verify exists only as a standalone resolver (D5); nothing in the intake/approve path calls it. Directive §14/§22 make these mandatory regression tests.
findings.problem: With no change to the build-ready check and no source check in prescreen, a card carrying source_id: QM-RESEARCH-2026-0001 (or source_author: Kimi) with NO resolvable artifact and NO valid sha PASSES R1 build-readiness and prescreen. The directive-mandated tests 'author=Kimi without artifact FAILS' and 'missing hash fails closed' therefore CANNOT pass with the design as written — the design claims the failure semantics but wires no gate that produces the failure. This lets an unbacked/hallucinated internal source masquerade as valid provenance (the exact agy-video-hallucination precedent, OPERATING_RULES §27).
findings.fix: Add a concrete, deterministic intake check (a new slice): when source_type=internal_research OR source_id/source_uri matches the QM-RESEARCH namespace, card intake MUST call research_source.py verify (resolve QM-RESEARCH://id -> path, recompute sha256 of source.md, compare to source_sha256, confirm research_source_ledger.jsonl entry exists) and FAIL CLOSED on any miss. Keep external cards untouched. Name the exact reject codes (e.g. INTERNAL_SOURCE_UNRESOLVABLE, INTERNAL_SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH) and add them to the prescreen reasons so --apply routes to cards_rejected. Only then can the §14/§22 tests be green.

findings.claim: Section 2.4: 'If Kimi's own tooling runs ML it does so inside the scoped dir ... the resulting numbers are re-derived deterministically in Python before they enter an artifact (the LLM's numbers are never the evidence — directive §6).' Section 0 invariant 2: 'Kimi never computes a metric, a p-value, or a correction.'
findings.evidence: Directive §6/§4: 'LLMs never compute metrics a script can compute.' No named tool, slice, or check in the draft or implementation plan performs or verifies the re-derivation. mechanization_check.py (§4.3) checks sections/ML-terms/param-bounds/model-dependency only; card prescreen checks no numeric provenance.
findings.problem: The re-derivation is asserted as policy but nothing enforces it. A number Kimi asserts (e.g. an observed conditional edge magnitude, a cluster separation, a confidence) can land in source.md/research.json unchecked, becoming 'evidence' that no script produced — precisely the determinism-first violation the directive bars. There is no deterministic gate distinguishing a script-computed figure from an LLM-asserted one.
findings.fix: Add a deterministic numeric-provenance rule: every quantitative claim in the QM-RESEARCH artifact must reference a computed output file (a projector/campaign JSON with its own sha256 recorded in research.json), and a check (extend mechanization_check.py or a new research_source verify step) that rejects an artifact whose stated metrics have no backing computed-file hash. State that Kimi's prose may cite only figures present in the provided deterministic summaries/dataset outputs.

findings.claim: Section 10 'Research objective metrics — how each is measured' presents all seven axes (novelty, independence, falsifiability, robustness, mechanizability, portfolio usefulness, reproducibility) as 'measured deterministically ... recorded per QM-RESEARCH id in research.json so a month's research can be judged on the seven axes.' Robustness 'from the DSR cohort / OPT_CENSUS'; Independence/Portfolio-usefulness from correlation_dev.json / portfolio_candidates.
findings.evidence: DSR cohorts are Q08 artifacts built after the EA runs (dsr_cohort.py:1 'for new Q08 work items'); portfolio_candidates (41 rows) and portfolio/correlation_dev.json are post-pipeline (audit data_memory §1.6, §2). A fresh pre-Q00 hypothesis has no backtest, no DSR cohort, no correlation vector, no portfolio candidacy.
findings.problem: The layer is explicitly pre-Q00 (§0), yet four of the seven 'measured' proxies require a backtested/validated EA that does not exist at HYPOTHESIZE/PRE-REGISTER time. As written the table invites either empty/UNAVAILABLE fields presented as scores, or after-the-fact backfill conflated with authoring-time judgement — and risks an LLM/heuristic 'robustness score' standing in for real pipeline evidence.
findings.fix: Split the table into authoring-time metrics computable pre-Q00 (novelty via fingerprint, mechanizability via mechanization_check, falsifiability via the FALSIFICATION section + critic score) versus post-validation metrics that can only be populated after Q00–Q17 (robustness via DSR/OPT_CENSUS, independence/portfolio-usefulness via correlation/portfolio_candidates, reproducibility once the pipeline has run). Mark the latter UNAVAILABLE at mint and populated by the LEARN projector after terminal verdicts. Never let a research-time proxy substitute for the pipeline's own robustness/portfolio evidence.

findings.claim: Section 2.3 hard-gates DISCOVER at 'D: free < 80 GB' (per D6); Section 1.3 mandates dataset output 'under D:/QM/reports/research/datasets/<stamp>/' (per D6); Section 11 says the escape is to 'write the dataset to C:/G:'.
findings.evidence: D6 fixes BOTH the D: output path and the 80 GB D: self-gate. Audit data_memory §5: D: = 65.6 GB free today (below 80). Datasets are 'a few MB' (§1.3, §11). Worker's own floor is DISK_MIN_FREE_GB=40 (terminal_worker.py:146).
findings.problem: The two D6 constraints deadlock today: the mandated output drive is below its own gate, so the layer is dead-on-arrival until purge frees space, and §11's C:/G: workaround contradicts D6's fixed D: location. An 80 GB free-gate to write a few-MB parquet is also mis-scoped relative to output size and the existing 40 GB worker floor that already protects backtests.
findings.fix: Surface this as an explicit OWNER/Fable reconciliation note (both constraints are D6, so it is inherited, not a draft fault): either (a) lower the research disk gate to a value consistent with few-MB outputs while staying safely above the 40 GB worker floor, or (b) allow the small dataset artifacts on C:/G: as the canonical location and reserve the 80 GB D: gate only for any large D: intermediate. Do not silently let §11's C:/G: escape override D6's fixed path without recording the decision.

findings.claim: Section 5 states agent_chain.v1.json by_creator_vendor.kimi 'lists only non-Kimi critics — [claude sonnet, codex terra, agy]' and cites 'router_providers.md §4 risk 7'.
findings.evidence: Audit router_providers.md §1/§4 and vault_contracts (a): agent_chain.v1.json vendors are claude/codex/agy today; there is NO kimi key anywhere (grep kimi/moonshot = no matches). Section 1 evidence inventory: the row counts (work_items 149,094; ea_metrics 100,110; transition_ledger 4,340; holds 5,366; poison 219; sources 118; portfolio_candidates 41; strategy 53,752 / infra 56,044 / measurement 19,962 / NULL 14,418) all match the audit exactly, and 'read ea_metrics, not the 45,008 gzip trees' is the right primitive.

Matches audit §5/§7.

Section 4 MECHANIZE: mechanization_check.py deterministic static checks (required sections incl. the six charter sections at card_intake_prescreen.py:379-425, no-ML-in-mechanics reusing the prescreen regex, finite bounded parameter count, MECH_MODEL_DEPENDENCY for any dataset/model reference, no runtime feed beyond native MT5 + live news filter) plus the binding Codex-implementability test.
